notes.title: Advanced Options & Chapter Selection – Update 1.3
notes.notes:
This update focuses on allowing you to change the way you play the game. From being able to fast-forward cutscenes to completely disabling the timing part of the battle system, we hope this customization makes Frameland more enjoyable to play for you.

Advanced Options
- Fast Forward: Fast forward cutscenes and dialogues.
While in a cutscene or talking to an NPC press Backspace or RB/R1.
- Battle Timing: Disable the timing mechanic in battles for a more relaxed experience. 
We have heard the feedback, that some players wanted to completely disable the timing component of the battles. Note that this reduces your agency of landing perfect hits and blocks (which are more chance based, when timing is turned off).
- Timing Indicator: Whether the timing indicator (crosshair) is visible in battle.
Can be turned off for an extra challenge or if you simply don’t like the crosshair being visible during battle.
- Remember Cursor: Retain cursor position between actions during battles
- Text Speed: How fast dialogues progress automatically

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/8b86138856e02c1ded5bcf4250b78c32963d8417.gif

Chapter Selection
Once you completed the game, you now have the ability to jump back to a previous point using the Chapter Select menu from the title screen. This will be handy if you missed an achievement on your playthrough (see guide). Note that when jumping to one of these chapters, the saves that are loaded are not your own, but predefined ones.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/7eda8b0fce8bd86e1dda0766b786d84502560180.png

Improvements
- Made more objects in Ailròs Highroad interactible
- Armor comparisons are now “more” correct. Previously it wouldn't show all relevant stats.
- Add new weapons to salesman on airship (Chapter 7)
- Quality of Life: Savemenu, don’t ask for overwrite confirmation if slot is empty
- Quality of Life: Exit menu, don’t confirm when recently saved
- Improved several music tracks

Bugfixes
- Fix battle texts sometimes "floating"
- Fix Paneca item not healing radiation
- Fix Stunbreak item not working
- Fix ticket quest when re-triggering sales
- Fix turn preview cursor being cutoff
- Fix some dark areas (e.g. mines) visual inconsistencies
- Fix misc collision issues

If you have any feedback or suggestions on other options you would like to see, or other ways to play the game, we are always happy to hear them.

notes.title: Version 1.2: Side Content Update
notes.notes:
Version 1.2 is here!
This late-game update brings fresh side content, powerful gear, tougher enemies, and hidden secrets. Whether you're exploring new areas or revisiting old ones, there’s plenty to discover!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/cf379bc0cd7de247fe7da77f5acd77e5cee89ed5.gif
Explore New Territories, Revisit Familiar Grounds
The airship's fast travel system has now been unlocked! Give previously-seen locations like Jasper, Trovo & Ailròs a second visit and discover what has changed during the events of the game. Or discover brand-new places where additional challenges wait!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/6ba5a866efd2d4b0dec6080a609fcfb3900e2475.png
The Facility
Located on an island far from civilization, this place seems a bit ... different. But not only that, the Swarms seem to be much stronger as well. If you're looking for a challenge, this is it!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/f2c1cb794b2ac89a854652a6ba3cd308a6915840.gif
Weapons, Remnants & Loot

 Over 10 new weapons & armors including each character's ultimate gear!
 2 new remnants with powerful abilities
 Many hidden treasures containing stat boosts and Sol



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/45269578e641597d111f99ff6a0e77e4860d3086.png
And more

 6 new enemies in previous locations
 New ability for the Borax Remnant: Shieldwall (Lv4)
 Fixed an issue where you could get softlocked at a savepoint. Thanks for the report @Litronom!
 Fixed several small typos
 Minor bugfixes

[hr][/hr]
And that's all for now.
Have fun with the update and see you in the next one!

notes.title: v1.1d: HP growth bugfix + de version fixes
notes.notes:
We Fixed a critical bug, that would lead to characters
gaining more HP than usual on a level-up!

If you are below level 10, you are unaffected by this change.

If you are above level 10, some of you characters might have a bit lower HP now.
If your HP was lowered, we put one Vigor Source item into your inventory as a small compensation.

Why did you lower my HP?
If left as is, this would have seriously impacted game balance.
The game, especially later on, would then be no challenge at all.

notes.title: Version 1.1 & German Translation Now Available!
notes.notes:
Dear friends,

We’re excited to launch version 1.1 of Frameland today!

German Translation

As promised, we're releasing the German translation today. Since our team is German-speaking, we handled the translation ourselves, so we're confident that both the English and German experiences are equal in quality.

For now, you’ll need to switch the language in Settings on the Title Screen. Automatic language detection based on Steam settings is not supported.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42995022/48d360e7d1feab6560e1758ef80919dc44eeb8ea.png

Reviews & Feedback

If you’re enjoying the game, leaving a review here on Steam would be awesome! Every single review makes a big difference in our visibility, helping more players discover the game.

We also love reading your honest feedback—what you like and what could be improved—whether in Steam discussions, on Discord, or on our social media, so we can continue refining the game.

Patch Notes
We've fixed a few minor bugs:
- Resolved an issue with the castle minigame that could cause players to be placed out of bounds
- Fixed screen flickering that occasionally occurred after battles
- Corrected an issue where an ability wouldn’t KO an enemy even when their HP reached 0 😭
- Fixed item descriptions to prevent them from breaking out of the screen during battles
- Minor script and wording improvements

Thanks for the amazing feedback so far! Next stop: side content — we've got some exciting stuff that we will announce soon!

Cheers,
Markus, Sebastian & Mario

notes.title: Frameland Demo and Release Date Revealed @ Steam RPG Fest
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that Frameland will be part of the Steam Turn-Based RPG Fest! 🥳 As the name suggests, this event celebrates turn-based role-playing games — just like Frameland!

To mark the occasion, we’re thrilled to unveil our first playable demo. We can’t wait for you to dive in, experience our timed battle system, and get your first look at the world and narrative we’ve been building.

⬇️ Download it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2137750/Frameland_A_Binary_Tale/

But that’s not all! We’re also happy to reveal the full release date — and the wait is almost over! After eight years of hard work, Frameland: A Binary Tale will release worldwide on October 30th, 2024 for Windows and Mac, available in English and German.

Here’s how you can get involved:

 Download and play the demo
 Share your thoughts with us! Either here in the discussions, on our other socials,
our Discord or via mail
 Wishlist the game on Steam
 Run into any issues? See the FAQ, but we are also happy to help directly.
 Spread the world and tell your friends about Frameland

We’re absolutely thrilled for you to finally step into the world of Frameland. Thank you for your patience, and we hope the adventure will be as unforgettable for you as it has been for us in creating it.

Cheers,
Markus, Sebastian & Mario
